name: adidas Yeezy Boost 380 'Covellite'
story_html: The adidas Yeezy Boost 380 ‘Covellite’ showcases a mix of navy, indigo, and grey tones throughout the re-engineered Primeknit upper. The camo-like design is punctuated by perforated detailing that accompanies the sneaker’s semi-translucent monofilament window, woven into the side panel to enhance the breathability of the sock-like build. Responsive cushioning arrives via a caged full-length Boost midsole, featuring a stacked, elevated heel and supported underfoot by a herringbone rubber outsole.
